searchLog: 9th+ straight day of the same network-egress failure (logged 2026-09-22 through 2026-09-29, now 2026-09-30 too). Tested 10 domains today: api.ashbyhq.com, job-boards.greenhouse.io, www.databricks.com, jobs.ashbyhq.com (mistral.ai and cursor slugs), stripe.com, jobs.lever.co (openai), www.metacareers.com, jobs.accel.com (a VC-hosted Greenhouse mirror, tried as a workaround), and github.com plus www.anthropic.com as controls — all EGRESS_BLOCKED by the proxy except the two anthropic.com/github.com controls, which load fine. So this is not a blanket network outage: github.com and www.anthropic.com's aggregate /careers/jobs listing both render normally, but every job-board vendor domain (Greenhouse, Ashby, Lever) and nearly every individual company careers domain is blocked, including third-party mirrors of the same Greenhouse listings (jobs.accel.com, indexventures.com, generalcatalyst.com all surfaced in search but are presumably equally blocked — accel was tested and confirmed blocked). Anthropic's own individual job-description URLs (e.g. www.anthropic.com/careers/jobs/5023394008) 307-redirect to job-boards.greenhouse.io, which is blocked, so even Anthropic roles cannot be verified past the aggregate title list (Applied AI Architect x8 teams, Forward Deployed Engineer in 6 cities, 7 TPM titles - unchanged from prior days, all already-seen per sent-log or unverifiable). WebSearch (not proxied) surfaced two live-looking leads I could not verify by fetch: a Databricks 'Associate Product Manager, New Grad (2027 Start)' (Bellevue/Mountain View/SF, wants grad Fall 2026 or Spring 2027 - fits Dom's window either way, $133-150k+bonus+equity per search snippet) and the Anthropic Fellows Program (rolling, Constellation-managed, no PhD required) - but per the verification rule neither can be included without loading the real application page, and databricks.com/greenhouse are both blocked. Zero verified opportunities is the correct output given zero fetchable non-Anthropic application pages for the 9th+ consecutive day. This is a proxy-configuration problem needing a human fix (widen the egress allowlist to at minimum *.greenhouse.io, *.ashbyhq.com, *.lever.co, and target companies' own careers domains such as www.databricks.com, www.metacareers.com, stripe.com) - not something a different search strategy, a mirror site, or a retry can work around; it has now blocked this pipeline's core function for well over a week straight.
